narr: Multiple shortwaves rotated around a low-pressure system over the Rockies. This produced slow-moving thunderstorms with heavy rain across parts of the Mid-South.
ev: At least six inches of water covered King Ridge Drive between Six Crowns Street and King Ridge Cove. A foot of water covered Byhalia Road south of West Powell Road.
